title: Auth (Better Auth)
summary: email-code sign-in with optional Google and Apple; one session on both transports (the browser's cookie jar, the phone's `Cookie` header from secure storage); `SessionGuard` for any endpoint; the sign-in screen on web and mobile; sign out and delete account on Settings; a mocked session that is a real cookie

placeholders.question: Which address sends the sign-in codes?

postScaffold: yarn db:generate && yarn db:migrate --name auth  (the four auth tables: user, auth_session, account, verification)
set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET in .env (at least 32 characters: `openssl rand -base64 32`) and BETTER_AUTH_URL to the origin the browser uses (http://localhost:5173 in dev — Vite proxies /api to the server)

optional: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and APPLE_CLIENT_ID/APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET turn the provider buttons on; without a pair the provider is not registered and its button answers with a refusal
mock mode boots signed in as the mock user (shared/contracts/mock-session.ts); sign out from Settings to reach the sign-in screen, then any email + code 12345 signs back in
